title: Instrument Capability Record
description: One record per addressable instrument/endstation. Design principle: separate WHAT you can learn (measurables) from HOW it is learned (techniques) from WHERE/WITH-WHAT (probe, resolution, sample constraints). The matchmaker resolves 'I want to measure X' -> measurables -> techniques -> instruments, then filters on constraints.

instrument_class.description: Coarse class; extend as facility classes are added. v0.2 added autonomous-lab classes (PoLARIS).

status.description: Operational status at retrieval time — selection must never route users to closed instruments

techniques.description: HOW: named experimental techniques offered. Names should be mappable to PaNET terms where they exist.

name.description: Canonical technique name, e.g. 'scanning transmission X-ray microscopy'

panet_id.description: PaNET ontology IRI/curie once mapped, e.g. 'PaNET:PaNET01100'. Empty until ontology alignment pass.

measurables.description: WHAT: physical quantities/properties a user can learn. This is the primary matchmaking axis. Use lowercase noun phrases, e.g. 'elemental composition', '3d microstructure', 'electronic band structure', 'oxidation state', 'protein solution shape'.

probe.description: The physical probe delivered to the sample

energy_range_eV.description: [min, max] in eV. For neutrons use meV converted to eV; for IR this can be sub-eV.

flux_notes.description: Free-text flux/brightness figures with units, verbatim from source

resolution.description: Best demonstrated resolutions. Always include units in the value strings if not using the numeric fields.

spatial_m.description: Best spatial resolution in meters (e.g. 2.5e-8 for 25 nm)

sample_constraints.description: What the instrument can accept — the feasibility filter

size_notes.description: Sample size limits, verbatim with units

sample_environments.description: In-situ/operando capabilities, e.g. 'cryostat 4K', 'heating to 1000C', 'diamond anvil cell', 'electrochemical cell', 'controlled humidity', 'applied magnetic field 5T'

type.description: e.g. '3d tomogram', '2d diffraction pattern series', 'xas spectrum'

typical_experiment_duration.description: e.g. '1-3 shifts per sample set' — free text

mechanism.description: e.g. 'general user proposal', 'rapid access', 'approved program', 'collaboration only'

cost_model.description: e.g. 'no-cost for publishable research; proprietary rates apply'

protocol_vocabulary.description: v0.3: relative path or URI to this instrument's protocol parameter vocabulary: the commandable operations and their parameter ranges, i.e. the machine-readable form of the IFM's protocol argument. Sourced from vendor documentation and/or instrument-team code; unknowns are null, never invented. Example: 'polaris_protocols/polaris-dsc2500.json'

throughput.description: v0.2 (from autonomous-lab catalogs): capacity data that beamline catalogs rarely state but campaign planning requires

availability.description: Operating schedule, e.g. '~20 hrs/day, 4 days/week' or 'by allocated beamtime'

automation.description: v0.2: HOW an agent can drive this instrument - the operation-capability block. This is the selection-layer's view of what PULSE-class operation needs per instrument.

control_interface.description: e.g. 'Python API', 'REST API', 'vendor GUI loosely integrated with Python', 'EPICS', 'ROS/LabVIEW', 'MHS driver (Model Hardware Standard, research preview 2026)'

orchestration.description: Workflow system the instrument is or will be a node of, e.g. 'MADSci node', 'Bluesky'

campaign_roles.description: v0.2: role(s) in a closed-loop campaign. Selection now spans MAKE (synthesis/processing) as well as MEASURE (characterization).

integration_dependencies.description: v0.2: what must exist before full autonomous operation, e.g. 'UR10e installation (FY26)'

urls.description: Beamline homepage and key documentation pages

demonstrated_applications.description: Short phrases for what has actually been measured here (from highlights/publications) — demonstrated performance beats spec sheets for matchmaking

notes.description: Which fields came from this source; extraction method

record_depth.description: 'directory' = breadth pass from facility directory table only; 'deep' = individual page extraction
